notes.title: Takara Cards: Academy is available!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Cadets!

Takara Cards: Academy is a free prologue to our newest game, [b]Takara Cards![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932210/Takara_Cards/

[h3]In it, you can create your character and explore the first sector of the game, as well as having access to the game's Codex and Tutorial.

And don't worry: [b]you can continue playing later[/b] with your cadet in the full version of Takara Cards!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/postmortempixels][b]Don't forget to follow our Steam page![/b][/url]

Happy hunting, Cadets![/h3]
